observation: Fresh main made durable event identity explicit, but mission createdAt/updatedAt remained unchecked and unpublished. list() sorts by updatedAt while eventObject() already owns updatedAt by assigning it from the newly appended event timestamp, so a persisted document could forge audit ordering or detach its visible update time from its event ledger.
changes: Require non-empty durable createdAt and updatedAt fields.
Bind updatedAt to the final durable event timestamp, preserving the writer invariant already enforced by eventObject().
Publish createdAt/updatedAt in Autonomous Mission v0.1 and add a focused tamper regression.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: validMissionShape did not inspect createdAt or updatedAt, and the schema did not publish them.
verification.post_fix_contract_replay: PASS: blank timestamps and updatedAt detached from the event tail fail closed while normal create/update state preserves equality with the final event timestamp.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/autonomous-mission-durable-timestamp-integrity.test.mjs covers generated timestamp behavior and durable tamper rejection.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not cryptographically authenticate timestamps or impose a wall-clock ordering policy across machines. It only preserves the timestamp relationship already produced by the existing mission writer.
